name: Toolscreen 1.2.8
body:
Setup video: https://youtu.be/YqS-fxPx_jo
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/jojoe77777

## New Features
- Added MPEG (not MPEG-2) video support for background images and image overlays
- Added options to let Alt+Tab and Alt+F4 work normally while using key rebinds
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed EyeZoom overlay animating out when transition is set to Cut
- Fixed the alt+tab option breaking key repeat for keys rebound from alt
- Fixed resize/toggle hotkeys that use the Windows key triggering start menu
- Fixed config buttons not working when the performance overlay is open
- Fixed the SwapBuffers hook sometimes being called twice per frame under specific conditions with third-party programs (OBS + Medal)
## Changes
- Restored the FPS limit slider to the main Settings page
- Cleaned up the Settings tab layout
- Implemented integration tests (only in dev environment)

How to update: If you're on 1.0.6 or higher, just launch your instance and it will prompt you to update
Otherwise, download the .jar below, put it in the instance folder, and double click it
# Patreon
If you would like to support the future development of Toolscreen, you can [subscribe through Patreon](<https://www.patreon.com/jojoe77777>), your name will show up in the Supporters tab of Toolscreen and you get access to exclusive supporter discord channels

name: Toolscreen 1.2.3
body:
Setup video: https://youtu.be/YqS-fxPx_jo
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/jojoe77777

## New Features
- Added browser overlays
- Added dynamic image sizing (no squishing ninjabrainbot)
- Added shift-layers for rebinding
- Added realtime mirrors and gradient mirror output
- Added animated GIF support for image overlays
- Added support for rebinding the Windows key
- Added a button to open custom cursor folder
- Added Preemptive mode to the Basic tab
- Added Simplified Chinese translations
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed Toolscreen not injecting into instances that use java.exe rather than javaw.exe
- Fixed window being positioned weirdly when using F11 to exit fullscreen
- Fixed static mirror borders being 1 frame behind
- Fixed some issues with fullscreen mode slider sizing
- Fixed custom cursor files not refreshing and cursor size not saving
- Fixed old mode references remaining in hotkey configs
- Fixed issues with eyezoom size settings updating while you're typing
- Fixed some issues with RTSS
- Fixed WM_CHAR rebinds spamming logs
- Potentially fixed some instability issues on some systems
## Changes
- Significant performance improvements in some cases
- Improved virtual camera performance and stability
- Cleaned up the mirror settings UI
- Added the borderless options into Advanced settings
- Made it harder to accidentally change the default mode
- Mirror sizes are now capped to 500x500 to discourage doing illegal things
- Fixed the top left popup always saying Ctrl+i even if you changed hotkey

How to update: If you're on 1.0.6 or higher, just launch your instance and it will prompt you to update
Otherwise, download the .jar below, put it in the instance folder, and double click it
# Patreon

name: Toolscreen 1.1.1
body:
Setup video: https://youtu.be/YqS-fxPx_jo
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/jojoe77777

## New Features
- **Added support for windowed mode**
- **Added keyboard layout and advanced rebinding options**
- **Added a hotkey to toggle whether key rebinding is enabled**
- **Added auto-borderless mode (fe-art)**
- Added more size & position customization for EyeZoom overlay
- Added the ability to double click sliders to set a more precise value (previously it was only ctrl+click)
- Added the ability to select a custom image for the EyeZoom overlay
- Added ability to configure which mode is the default (fe-art)
- Added a Supporters tab for the Patreon
- Added an API for other programs to communicate with Toolscreen

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed hotkeys not working with rebinds (fe-art)
- Fixed multiple color keys not working for image & window overlays (fe-art)
- Fixed rebinding modifier keys not working
- Fixed EyeZoom rendering issues with fog (low render distance, pause menu, or underwater)
- Fixed a bug with default GUI hotkey being incorrect under rare circumstances
- Fixed the EyeZoom overlay not centering properly with resolutions other than 384 width
- Fixed the hotkeys for toggling overlay visibility not working while in config GUI
- Fixed a softlock when binding something to left click

## Changes
- Prevent setting duplicate hotkeys (fe-art)
- Changed hook chaining to enabled by default to support third-party overlays
- Added a note that Raw Input be enabled for sensitivity changes

How to update: If you're on 1.0.6 or higher, just launch your instance and it will prompt you to update
Otherwise, download either the .exe or the .jar below, put it in the instance folder, and double click it

name: Toolscreen 1.0.9
body:
Setup video: https://youtu.be/YqS-fxPx_jo
Ko-fi for donations: https://ko-fi.com/jojoe77777

- Fixed Toolscreen not working when using "javaw" rather than specifying the java path
- Added experimental hook chaining to support third-party overlays like MSI Afterburner. This is disabled by default, you can enable it by setting "disableHookChaining" in config.toml to "false"
- Potentially fixed some rare bugs with mirrors
- Fix bad font selection lagging the game
- Potentially fixed some other issues with OpenGL context stability
- Reduced exception spam in logs

## Download either the .exe or .jar, both are used the same, put it in the instance folder and double click
Exe is less likely to be falsely blocked by antivirus when downloading

name: Toolscreen 1.0.6
body:
Setup video: https://youtu.be/YqS-fxPx_jo
Ko-fi for donations: https://ko-fi.com/jojoe77777

## Features
- Added auto-updater, when you launch the instance it will show a popup to download new version before launching
- Added option to skip excluding from Windows Defender
- Added prelaunch.txt, each line will be executed as a command when launching
- Added a tall Preemptive mode, it can have its own sens & hotkey
## Changes
- Removed EyeZoom FPS Limit option
- Excluded the Minecraft window from being captured by a Window Overlay
## Bug fixes
- Fixed issues with third-party overlay/FPS limiting tools like MSI Afterburner, this resolves a number of issues with "Ctrl+i not working"
- Support Unicode characters in file paths
- Fix wrong java installation being used in Injector
- Fixed injector not detecting window sometimes
- Potential fix for font GUI corruption
- Fixed DLL base address not being logged

How to update: Download the new .jar, put it in the instance folder, double click it, follow the prompts. You will keep your existing config settings

name: Toolscreen 1.0.5
body:
Setup video: https://youtu.be/YqS-fxPx_jo
Ko-fi for donations: https://ko-fi.com/jojoe77777

Patches in 1.0.5:
- Fixed a bug with color backgrounds in EyeZoom mode covering the middle section
- Fixed a bug with the EyeZoom FPS limit slider in settings
- Addressed potential flicker issues with EyeZoom clone

Changelog from 1.0.4:

## Installer
- Now prompts for permission to exclude itself in Windows Defender
## New Features
- Added a hotkey to toggle borderless mode
- Added a hotkey to toggle visibility of all image overlays, or all window overlays
- Added an option to not have measuring pixels on the whole EyeZoom overlay, just in the middle
- Supports rebinding mouse buttons & keys like Right Shift
## Changes
- Increased the range for sensitivity sliders to 0.001 <-> 10.0
- Made the "Press Ctrl+i" prompt in the top left fade out after 10 seconds
- Increased default font size & measuring overlay width for EyeZoom
- Added an FPS limit to the EyeZoom clone, defaulting to 60 fps
- Disable "Only on my screen" for mirrors due to potential cheating issues
- Added a hint about using Ctrl+Click in the GUI for slider input
- Fixed various performance issues (more improvements yet to come)
## Bug fixes
- Fixed "Reset to Defaults" in modes tab setting width & height of thin & wide to 1 pixel
- Fixed "Reset to Defaults" in mirrors tab not restoring mirror groups
- Fixed key binding where it said a key was being held down when it wasn't
- Fixed Window Overlays being missing from thin & wide modes
- Fixed mirror output size/position not reloading properly when set to a relative percentage
- Fixed custom theme colours not saving when restarting
- Fixed mode width & height changes not saving when edited in the Basic tab
- Fixed being able to drag window overlays after closing the config GUI
- Potential fix for custom fonts causing rendering issues with the config GUI
- Potential fix for a crash when editing config or using EyeZoom mode
- Other fixes for performance & flicker issues
